conditions.scope: AudioYT jukebox discovery and change tracking

change.summary: Discover AudioYT jukeboxes from loaded chunk block entities instead of repeatedly scanning nearby block coordinates.

before.discovery: Every 5 server ticks, scan 33x17x33 block positions around every player.
before.missing_chunk: Direct ServerLevel.getBlockState may synchronously load or generate an absent chunk.

after.discovery: Inspect the block-entity map once when an already loaded LevelChunk enters the logical server and register each JukeboxBlockEntity through AudioYT's native forceCheck API.
after.updates: AudioYT's native JukeboxBlockEntity setItem Mixin updates disc changes, and its known-jukebox loop retains its hasChunkAt guard.
after.missing_chunk: No discovery path requests or generates an absent chunk.

modifiers.notes: Playback, disc metadata, record state, recipes and the vanilla jukebox registry remain owned by AudioYT and Minecraft.

rationale.purpose: Prevent AudioYT jukebox discovery from blocking the server tick while preserving native playback and disc-change behavior.
rationale.decision_source: User requested a better solution than constant scanning on 2026-10-31. The local watchdog trace and exact installed AudioYT 1.0.1 bytecode identify the unguarded repeated block scan, while AudioYT's existing setItem hook and loaded-only known-position loop provide the native incremental path.

introduced.summary: Replace repeated nearby block scanning with loaded-chunk jukebox discovery and native incremental updates.

history.summary: Keep discovery inside loaded chunk block-entity maps after AudioYT's direct nearby block read caused a local watchdog crash.

relations: LevelChunk load -> existing JukeboxBlockEntity -> AudioYT forceCheck
JukeboxBlockEntity setItem -> AudioYT native incremental update
notes: The vanilla jukebox registration and recipe graph remain unchanged.
The adapter is enabled only for the inspected AudioYT 1.0.1 artifact.
unresolved: Player rejoin, sustained server uptime and custom-disc playback after this change remain in testing until runtime acceptance.
